info.title: tauCloud M7 experimental NFS management and file-core API
info.description: Loopback HTTPS backend preview. WebDAV uses a separate optional TLS listener; see m3.md for DAV limits, recovery and client validation. Core file chunks remain 128 KiB, IPC 512 KiB. Browser writes require exact Origin and CSRF. Management and file rights are separate. Paths use portable UTF-8 NFC. FTP/explicit FTPS uses a separate optional loopback listener with mandatory data TLS session reuse; see m4.md. SMB 2.1 uses a separate optional loopback listener with required signing and NTLMv2 MIC. Enroll SMB credentials separately; see m5.md for bounded file/RPC coverage and unsupported ACLs. NFS offers an experimental loopback AUTH_SYS profile with explicit nfs-exports enrollment. Complete v4.1/v3 compatibility is not claimed; see m7.md.
